meta.name: Coldd Lassi Aur Chicken Masala
meta.description:
Fate brings ex-lovers Nitya, Indie Spice's head chef, and Vikram, a Michelin Star chef, together after 8 yrs. Memories of the lost love return along with the bitterness of past, leading to a sweet and spicy story with love aur drama ka tadka.

Ended · First aired 3 Sept 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 28 min
Studio: Linga Bhairavi Devi Productions · Network: ALTBalaji, Weyyak

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Raita Phail Gaya
videos.overview: Nitya, a single mother's world turns upside down when her ex-husband, Vikram, a renowned Michelin Star chef, takes over the reaturant she works at as the head chef. Will Nitya be able to forget the past and maintain a professional relationship with Vikram?

videos.title: Not-so-Dost Ka Roast
videos.overview: A week after Vikram takes over, the team decides to go out for dinner. The evening doesn’t go well and a drunk Nitya goes on stage and roasts her new boss publicly. Later, she feels guilty about her behaviour and decides to apologise to Vikram. But when she reaches his house, she’s shocked to learn that Manira, his friend and business partner, is pregnant.

videos.title: Haal-e-Haldi Haldi
videos.overview: Vikram is shooting with a TV crew at the restaurant and wants to do the last segment of the show with Nitya. She agrees but is seething with anger after finding out about Manira’s pregnancy. Once the shooting wraps up, the duo ends up having another argument. Nitya tells Tanvi about Manira. Later in the evening, Vikram is stunned when she introduces him to Karan,her friend and neighbour, as her boss.

videos.title: Kuch Bitter Kuch Sweet
videos.overview: Kyzaad thinks Vikram cannot be a good father and advises him to pull up his socks and make a plan to get his son back. Meanwhile, Nitya overhears a heated argument between Manira and Vikram and assumes that Vikram is once again about to leave a pregnant woman. She is determined to stop him at any cost.

videos.title: Midnight Masala
videos.overview: Nitya lands up at Vikram’s house to apologise when the news of a terror attack breaks out. Nitya is left with no option but to spend the night at his house. Vikram asks Kyzaad to be with Vivaan and Tanvi. During the night, Vikram and Nitya have a heart-to-heart conversation. Meanwhile, Manira is moved by an incident and decides not to abort her child.

videos.title: Dil, Dimag, aur Dard-e-Dum
videos.overview: It’s the opening of the restaurant and Vikram and Nitya look comfortable and happy in each other’s company. Vikram meets Vivaan for the first time and rushes to meet Nitya to share his happiness. However, Nitya and Karan’s chemistry is misinterpreted by Vikram and he starts behaving cold towards Nitya. Things turn worse when Vikram’s mother arrives and comes face to face with Nitya.

videos.title: Sharm Ka Saag Aur Makkari Ki Roti
videos.overview: Nitya is disturbed when she comes face to face with Vikram’s mother who accuses her of using her son. Nitya gives her an earful and Vikram too asks his mother not to interfere in his life. A glimpse into the past reveals Vikram's one mistake that ruined his beautiful relationship with Nitya.

videos.title: Cheating Chello Kebabs
videos.overview: Vikram arrives at Nitya’s doorstep with her favourite Chello Kebabs. But it brings back memories of the day when her world came crashing down. Karan tells Nitya that she must question Vikram on his past actions. Later, Vikram requests his mother to not interfere between him and his son.

videos.title: Ek Tub Ice-cream, Do Scoop Dhokha
videos.overview: Vikrant and Nitya are divided over Gauri and Shekhar's divorce. Karan’s ex-wife suggests that he asks Nitya out. To forget their troubles, Nitya and Gauri get drunk and hit a night club.

videos.title: Kabhi Neem Neem, Kabhi Shehed Shehed
videos.overview: Nitya goes on a date with Karan. Meanwhile, Vikram, who is babysitting Vivaan, has a great time with him. Tanvi and Kayzad consider moving in together.

videos.title: Galouti Gileh Shikwey
videos.overview: Vikram apologises to Nitya for his past actions and tells her that he never stopped loving her. Later, they spend the night together. The next day Vikram leaves for Delhi without meeting her. Will Nitya follow him to Delhi?

videos.title: Mashed in Mohabbat, Baked in Love
videos.overview: Nitya is heartbroken after she sees Vikram with Seema together and confronts the two. Vikram asks her if she trusts him. A year later, Nitya is accepted into the famous Le Cordon Bleu College thanks to Vikram’s recommendation.
